title: CoMix: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multi-Task Comic Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying extracted character image crops into gender categories (Male, Female, Animals, Other) using a state-of-the-art open-source Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to calculate representation percentages.

Analyzing dataset composition and explicitly balancing the inclusion of different comic styles and origins (Japanese manga, American comics, and French Bandes Dessinées) to mitigate the over-representation of specific cultural styles.

Using a Large Language Model (Llama3-80B) to automatically classify panel-level textual content into varying levels of offensiveness, including a specific category for 'Highly Offensive/Racist/Sexist' content, followed by manual verification of the flagged panels.
